# Copilot Instructions — Super Planner 9000
1. Always follow the [readme/SPEC.md](../readme/SPEC.md) specification when writing code for the Super Planner 9000 project.
2. Always ensure you are in the project directory before running any commands.
3. Always run project checks (`npm run check`) before handing off code.
4. Run a specific test file with `npm run test -- path/to/testfile.test.ts`.
5. Run a specific test within a file with `npm run test -- path/to/testfile.test.ts -t "test name"`.
